tasks.description: Package exposes a generic append-only SessionEventStore contract with ordered events and revision metadata.
steps: Verify packages/agent/src/runtime/session-event-store.ts exports RuntimeSessionEvent variants for InputAppended, RunStarted, RunCompleted, RunFailed, and RunInterrupted.
Verify StoredRuntimeSessionEvent includes id, sessionId, revision, and event.
Verify SessionEventStore exposes load and append only, with no app auth, database, HTTP, WebSocket, or Cloudflare imports.
Run pnpm --filter @yolk-sdk/agent/runtime test:run and confirm SessionEventStore append/replay tests pass.

tasks.description: Runtime AppendInput mode replays prior protocol transcript state and persists input/start/completion events.
steps: Verify packages/agent/src/runtime/run-runtime.ts supports RuntimeRequest._tag AppendInput with sessionId, input, runId, and expectedRevision.
Verify AppendInput loads SessionEventStore, replays prior InputAppended and RunCompleted events, appends InputAppended and RunStarted before loop execution, and appends RunCompleted after success.
Verify replayRuntimeSessionEvents returns protocol AgentMessage values only, preserving ordered assistant/tool parts and ToolResult.isError metadata while excluding runtime lifecycle metadata.
Run pnpm --filter @yolk-sdk/agent/runtime test:run and confirm append input replay/completion tests pass.

tasks.description: Runtime records failed and interrupted runs without fabricating assistant or tool protocol messages.
steps: Verify AppendInput catches loop/runtime failures and appends RunFailed using runtimeErrorToAgentError.
Verify replayRuntimeSessionEvents excludes RunFailed and RunInterrupted payloads from transcript reconstruction.
Verify latestIncompleteRuntimeRun returns latest started run without RunCompleted, RunFailed, or RunInterrupted.
Run pnpm --filter @yolk-sdk/agent/runtime test:run and confirm failure/interruption tests pass.

tasks.description: Append stores detect stale writes through numeric expectedRevision conflict semantics.
steps: Verify SessionRevision is numeric and appendRuntimeSessionEventsToLog increments revisions deterministically.
Verify makeInMemorySessionEventStoreLayer rejects stale expectedRevision with SessionConflictError.
Verify runRuntime AppendInput passes expectedRevision and surfaces SessionConflictError on stale input.
Run pnpm --filter @yolk-sdk/agent/runtime test:run and confirm conflict tests pass.

tasks.description: Existing transcript mode stays stateless while append mode is opt-in.
steps: Verify RuntimeRequest remains a union of Transcript and AppendInput.
Verify Transcript mode in runRuntime does not require SessionEventStore and does not load or append persisted state.
Verify runRuntime transcript tests pass without a store layer.
Run pnpm --filter @yolk-sdk/agent/runtime test:run.

tasks.description: Cloudflare Durable Object adapter persists runtime append logs through SessionEventStore instead of whole-transcript blob overwrites.
steps: Verify cloudflare/agent/src/yolk-agent.ts provides a SessionEventStore backed by Durable Object storage.
Verify the adapter uses appendRuntimeSessionEventsToLog for revision/id generation.
Verify WebSocket user inputs call runRuntime in AppendInput mode.
Run pnpm cloudflare:check.

tasks.description: Cloudflare tests cover multiple persisted WebSocket turns and event log contents.
steps: Add/verify a Cloudflare adapter test that sends two user inputs to one Durable Object session.
Verify responses are replay-aware: the second run receives prior protocol AgentMessages plus the new UserMessage input.
Verify durable storage contains ordered InputAppended, RunStarted, and RunCompleted events for both runs.
Run pnpm cloudflare:check and pnpm test:run.

tasks.description: Cloudflare reconnect cleanup marks latest incomplete run interrupted without mutating transcript replay.
steps: Add/verify a Cloudflare adapter test with a stored log containing a RunStarted event without a terminal event.
Open/reconnect the session and verify RunInterrupted is appended for the active run before accepting new input.
Verify replayed transcript excludes the interrupted run lifecycle event.
Run pnpm cloudflare:check and pnpm test:run.

tasks.description: Package and adapter docs explain append-store boundaries, conflict behavior, and host responsibilities.
steps: Verify packages/agent/AGENTS.md documents Transcript vs AppendInput modes, append events, replay semantics, expectedRevision, and host-owned cleanup.
Verify packages/AGENTS.md durable runtime section reflects current implementation and remaining work.
Verify cloudflare/agent/AGENTS.md documents Durable Object append-log storage and reconnect interruption behavior.
Add README examples for Transcript vs AppendInput usage when runtime API surface stabilizes, or document why README examples remain deferred.

patterns: Effect services/layers for storage and runtime dependencies.
Protocol transcript uses @yolk-sdk/agent/protocol AgentMessage only; UI render models stay out of runtime persistence.
Replay preserves ordered assistant parts and generic ToolResult.isError metadata by persisting protocol messages rather than UI-local tool state.
Append replay derives transcript from InputAppended and RunCompleted only.
Runtime tests use @effect/vitest, fake providers, and in-memory stores.
Cloudflare app is a thin adapter; generic behavior belongs in packages/* first.
Cloudflare source imports use explicit .ts relative extensions.
nonGoals: UI thread list, drafts, model picker, or command palette.
Database migrations or concrete Drizzle schema.
projectConstraints: Run pnpm packages:check when touching packages/*.
Run pnpm cloudflare:check when touching cloudflare/*.
No any, no non-null assertions, no type assertions.
No raw JSON parse/stringify in production Effect code; use Schema.UnknownFromJsonString at boundaries.
No app/auth/storage/provider SDK imports in reusable packages.
Prefer Effect Array/Option and Ref patterns over mutable runtime state.
existingImplementation: SessionEventStore contract exists with load/append, numeric SessionRevision, in-memory layer, and conflict semantics.
RuntimeSessionEvent variants exist for InputAppended, RunStarted, RunCompleted, RunFailed, and RunInterrupted.
appendRuntimeSessionEventsToLog centralizes stored event ids and revision increments.
replayRuntimeSessionEvents reconstructs protocol transcript messages from append logs.
latestIncompleteRuntimeRun finds active runs from event logs.
runRuntime supports stateless Transcript mode and append-backed AppendInput mode.
AppendInput records input/start/completion/failure and uses expectedRevision.
Agent runtime tests cover append, replay, conflict, failure, interruption helper, and transcript compatibility.
Cloudflare Durable Object adapter uses SessionEventStore over Durable Object storage and interrupts incomplete runs on reconnect.
Cloudflare tests cover error mapping, multi-turn durable event logs, and reconnect interruption.
